research.title: Evaluating Object Detection Under Partial Occlusion
bullets: Designed controlled evaluations of pretrained object detectors using synthetic occlusions, separating effects of object visibility, occluder placement, and background complexity.
Analyzed detection errors across object sizes and occlusion conditions, examining confidence shifts and localization failures against unoccluded reference images.

research.title: Illumination Robustness in Road Scene Segmentation
bullets: Designed experiments comparing photometric augmentation and consistency training for semantic segmentation under exposure changes, shadows, and low illumination.
Analyzed classwise segmentation errors and boundary quality across lighting conditions, using ablations to distinguish augmentation effects from training configuration differences.

publications.title: Photometric Augmentation and Consistency Training for Road Scene Segmentation Under Illumination Shift
Classwise Error Analysis of Road Scene Segmentation Across Lighting Conditions

work.title: Image Upload Validation and Processing Maintenance
bullets: Implemented assigned validation checks for image uploads, handling unsupported formats, inconsistent dimensions, and malformed metadata within an existing processing service.
Investigated processing failures through application logs, added regression tests for reproduced defects, and documented expected behavior for maintenance handoffs.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Image Retrieval Representations
bullets: Implemented image retrieval baselines using color histograms and pretrained convolutional features, applying consistent preprocessing and similarity scoring across representations.
Compared retrieval rankings under cropping and color perturbations, inspecting failure cases involving background similarity and changes in object appearance.

projects.title: Classical and Learned Image Denoising
bullets: Implemented median filtering, Gaussian smoothing, and a convolutional denoising baseline for images corrupted with additive noise and impulse noise.
Evaluated reconstruction quality and edge preservation using matched corruption settings, comparing visual artifacts and sensitivity to noise types across methods.
